method: Targeted official-domain search followed by standard-library HTTPS retrieval; indexed-only records are not treated as retrieved evidence.

supports: TAG report index and replacement-source discovery
limitations: index does not itself establish local displacement or baseline
consultation and traffic-light status are not an attributable displaced-programme or budget decision
official search index describes the record, but direct retrieval returned 404; retain as inaccessible lead and do not promote indexed text

refresh_rule: Reacquire indexed-only or 404 records if a canonical replacement appears; invalidate dependent context receipts when URL, bytes, revision, or terms change.
